fusions.name: Pulp Spur
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws a spur of hardened pulp for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its maximum range of 6 tiles. The target is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Accreted Stacks
fusions.desc: Raises a reef of hardened pages around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Living Watermark
fusions.desc: Grows a field of wet pulp 3 tiles across where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Layer Upon Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a layer of pulp sets on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per layer (56% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 6 seconds.
